import sys, time, json, subprocess; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from wire import v

# 8192 explicit stream pairs, byte writes at descending offsets (front insertion in ledgers)
events=[]
pn=0
CH=250
envs=[]
NS=8000
for i in range(NS):
    sid=4*i
    # stream frame: OFF|LEN (0x0e), offset = 2000- (i%2000), length 1
    payload=b'\x0e'+v(sid)+v(2000-(i%2000))+v(1)+b'x'
    envs.append((0x40).to_bytes(1,'big')+b'\xaa'+pn.to_bytes(1,'big')+payload)
    pn=(pn+1)%256
for i in range(0,len(envs),CH):
    events.append({'datagram':{'wire':b''.join(envs[i:i+CH]).hex(),'auth':[0]*min(CH,len(envs)-i)}})
print('events',len(events),'packets',len(envs))
batch={'traces':[{'limits':{'connection':4611686018427387903,'stream':4611686018427387903,'bidi':2**60,'uni':2**60,'cids':4},
                  'local':{'bidi':2,'uni':2,'cids':['aa','bb']},'peer':{'cid':'cc','token':'00'*16},
                  'received':{'I':None,'H':None,'A':None},'events':events}]}
data=json.dumps(batch).encode()
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run(['python3','/workspace/run.py','/workspace/tmp/classes'],input=data,capture_output=True)
t1=time.time()
out=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
if 'traces' not in out: print('INPUT error',out)
else:
    r=out['traces'][0]
    print('time',round(t1-t0,2),'streams',len(r['streams']),'opened',r['opened'],'used',r['used'])
